name: Bun's Dream
source:
A brutal winter has rocked the city in which Bun lives, snowing everyone in and inviting freezing temperatures. As Bun struggles with the given circumstances, she is visited by a mysterious boy in her dreams...

[From [url=https://taylorsconfused.itch.io/buns-dream]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
严酷的冬天震撼了邦所居住的城市，所有人都被大雪覆盖，气温极低。当小面包在特定环境中挣扎时，一个神秘男孩在她的梦中拜访了她……

[来自[url=https://taylorsconfused.itch.io/buns-dream]itch.io[/url]]
